description: GPU models that meet a memory and price requirement, cheapest first: for each card its cheapest live on-demand rate card (provider, read time, page), its median rate card and panel size, VRAM and price per GB of VRAM. Community capacity and marketplace floors are out unless the market is set.

market.description: Market of the cheapest rate; default on_demand.

max_usd_per_gpu_hour.description: Highest acceptable rate per GPU-hour, compared with each card's cheapest rate. Optional.

min_vram_gb.description: Least memory per GPU, in GB (24, 48, 80, 141...). Default 0.

region.description: Rates listed in US or EU regions, plus rates that name no region (a provider's rate everywhere); default any.

name: find_gpus

cite_as.description: How to cite this answer: GPU Economy, the page, the data date.

title: Find GPUs that meet a requirement
